cf.notes: 10-K cash flow statement as originally filed (USD thousands /1,000). wc_change = sum of all 'Changes in operating assets and liabilities' lines (AR, inventories, AP, accrued income taxes, accrued liabilities & customer deposits, other assets & liabilities). other_op = excess tax benefits from stock options + discontinued ops (computed as cfo less named lines). other_fin = excess tax benefits from stock options + debt financing costs. other_inv = 'Acquisition purchase price adjustments' (computed cfi less named lines). The FY2010 10-K (and XBRL) re-presented 2009 CFO as 162.3 (other assets & liabilities -4,767 vs -6,546) with FX effect 12.7 vs 14.5; original figures kept here.
